title: Observer-Robust Control of Obstruction Diagnostics
description: This paper establishes a formal architecture for the observer-robust control of discrete constraint systems. Shifting from a single-metric view of system error, the work defines a repair-policy layer that operates over a bundle of observer-induced geometries. A control policy (Ctrl) is defined as observer-robust if its performance remains bounded across a declared class of admissible observers. The core contribution is the operationalization of the Observer-Robust Control Criterion, evaluating policies based on their ability to stabilize obstruction diagnostics without assuming a universally privileged metric, preventing unmonitored residual surges and bounding coordinate diagnostics under joint detector adequacy.
